title: Add RAG templates, agent tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: make it faster for engineers to adopt RAG and agent tool-calling patterns by shipping curated templates, end-to-end examples, and docs site quickstarts. This PR adds three RAG templates (faq, sop, customer-support), two agent tool-calling examples (calendar booking in Python, semantic-search + results tool in TypeScript), updates the docs site with a new Quickstarts section and sidebar entries, and includes tests and example fixtures. Checklist: add templates; add examples; update docs site navigation and quickstarts; add integration smoke tests; fix docs-lint failures. Summary of changes: 8 new docs pages under redwood-docs/content/quickstarts and docs/rag, 2 example apps under redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling, siteConfig and sidebar tweaks, small test harness for example mocks, and README updates. Testing: examples run under CI with mocked tool backends; docs-lint and website build passed after minor markdown fixes; examples integration flaky on first run (timeout) but rerun succeeded. Related work: ENG-4521 (RAG templates), PM-982 (quickstarts); incident SUP-9812 referenced for improved onboarding. Merge notes: squash-merged after approvals and one follow-up fix for sidebar ordering. No breaking changes.
